description.zh: 所属A号码组ID。在[资质管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/qualification)页面所属资质的A号码白名单栏单击查看详情。
description.en: ID of the group to which Number A belongs. On the [Qualification Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/qualification) Page, go to the A-number whitelist section of the relevant qualification and click View Details.

description.zh:
法定代表人/经办人手机号
>若该资质下有移动X号码，则此字段必填，否则将审核不通过。
description.en:
Phone number of the legal representative or agent.  
>If this qualification includes a Mobile X number, this field is Required; otherwise, the Review will Fail.

description.zh:
固话客户类型。取值：

- 1：法定代表人。

- 2：经办人。
description.en:
Fixed-line customer type. Valid values:

- 1: Legal representative.

- 2: Agent.

description.zh: 证件类型，填写1表示身份证。
description.en: Certificate type. Enter 1 for ID card.

description.zh: 固话申请时线下服务大厅工单号。
description.en: Ticket number from the offline service hall when applying for a fixed-line number.

description.zh: 正面人像照片OSS路径地址。
description.en: OSS path of the front-facing portrait photo.

description.zh: 身份证反面（人像面）照片OSS路径地址。
description.en: OSS path of the photo of the back (portrait side) of the ID card.

description.zh: 身份证正面（国徽面）照片OSS路径地址。
description.en: OSS path of the photo of the front (national emblem side) of the ID card.

description.zh: 备注（用户自身的业务备注）。

title.zh: 提交A号码固话个人实名信息
title.en: Submit Individual Real-name Information for Landline Number A

descriptions.zh:
在调用此接口前，您需要先调用[GetDyplsOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~2880885~~)将个人照片信息上传至OSS，具体操作流程请参见[API提交A号码个人实名信息](~~2880077~~)。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before invoking this API, you need to first call [GetDyplsOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~2880885~~) to upload the individual's photo information to OSS. For the detailed operation flow, see [Submit Individual Real-name Information for Number A via API](~~2880077~~).
### queries per second (QPS) limit
The QPS limit for this API is 50 queries per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, Rate Limiting will be applied to your API Call, which may Impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
